## What's new

- **Home screen widget.** A now-playing widget with the artwork, title and artist, and previous, play/pause and next buttons. When you place it, Kultr asks how solid its background should be — anywhere from 100% (solid) to 0% (invisible); long-press the widget and choose reconfigure to change it later. Tap the artwork or title to open the player.
- **Works with KWGT and other media controllers.** Kultr now registers as a music player for media buttons, so KWGT (and similar apps) list it as a player and can read what is playing and control it. Headset and Bluetooth buttons also start Kultr again after it was closed.
- **Pick up where you left off.** Pressing play with nothing loaded — from a headset, the widget, KWGT or Android's media controls — resumes the last queue at the position it stopped.

## Install

Download **Kultr-1.2.0.apk** below and open it on your phone. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your servers, library and downloads. Requires Android 8.0 or later.
